name: blocked-placement-pill
description: Bug #6: a blocked (invalid) pending edit shows the Apply pill with a greyed-out, non-clickable confirm tick + a can't-apply tooltip; confirm is a no-op while blocked.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: wait-pill
steps.failMessage: blocked pill label did not render

steps.name: assert-tick-disabled
steps.eval: (()=>{const b=document.querySelector('.edit-confirm-btn.confirm');if(!b)throw new Error('no confirm tick');if(!(b instanceof HTMLButtonElement)||!b.disabled)throw new Error('confirm tick should be disabled while blocked');if(!/can.t apply/i.test(b.getAttribute('title')||''))throw new Error('missing cant-apply tooltip')})()

steps.name: click-disabled-tick-noop
steps.eval: (()=>{const b=document.querySelector('.edit-confirm-btn.confirm');b.click();if(!window.__store.getState().pendingEdit)throw new Error('blocked edit was committed on tick click — should be a no-op');if(!window.__store.getState().pendingEdit.blocked)throw new Error('pending edit lost its blocked flag')})()
